description: Use this when the user wants to compare take-home pay for two US paycheck scenarios in 2026 side by side: 'should I take the job in Texas or California after taxes', two job offers in different states or cities, a raise, a different pay frequency, or 'how much more per paycheck if I raise my 401k to 10%'. Give scenario a in full and scenario b with only the fields that change (everything else is copied from a). Returns both breakdowns (federal withholding, FICA, state taxes, net per check and per year) and the difference, plus a side-by-side PDF and a CSV. Does not compare cost of living, benefits, or run payroll.

a.description: Scenario A in full, e.g. {annual_salary: 95000, state: 'TX', pay_frequency: 'biweekly', label: 'Austin'}.

annual_salary.description: Yearly salary before taxes in USD, e.g. 85000. Give this, or hourly_rate, or gross_per_paycheck.

children_under_17.description: Qualifying children under 17 for W-4 Step 3 ($2,200 each in 2026), e.g. 2. Ignored if w4_step3_amount is given.

claim_overtime_deduction.description: True to add the 2026 qualified overtime deduction (the 'half' of time-and-a-half, up to $12,500 or $25,000 married) to W-4 Step 4(b), as the 2026 W-4 worksheet allows. Needs hourly_rate and overtime hours.

filing_status.description: Form W-4 Step 1(c) filing status: single (or married filing separately, default), married (filing jointly), head_of_household.

gross_per_paycheck.description: Gross pay per paycheck in USD before any deductions, e.g. 3200. Use instead of a salary or hourly rate.

health_insurance_per_paycheck.description: Pre-tax (section 125) health, dental and vision premiums and FSA per paycheck in USD, e.g. 120.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly wage in USD, e.g. 22 for $22 an hour. Combine with hours_per_week.

hours_per_week.description: Regular hours worked per week for hourly pay, e.g. 40. Defaults to 40.

hsa_per_paycheck.description: HSA contribution through payroll per paycheck in USD, e.g. 75.

k401_per_paycheck.description: Traditional 401(k) contribution in dollars per paycheck, e.g. 200. Use instead of k401_percent.

k401_percent.description: Traditional (pre-tax) 401(k) or 403(b) contribution as a percent of gross pay, e.g. 6 for 6%.

label.description: Short name for this scenario, e.g. 'Austin offer' or '401k at 10%'.

locality.description: Optional local tax area where the state supports it, e.g. nyc, yonkers, philadelphia, or a Maryland or Indiana county such as montgomery or marion.

other_dependents.description: Other dependents for W-4 Step 3 ($500 each), e.g. 1.

overtime_hours_per_week.description: Overtime hours per week paid at overtime_multiplier, e.g. 5. Defaults to 0.

overtime_multiplier.description: Overtime pay multiplier, e.g. 1.5 for time-and-a-half (default) or 2 for double time.

pay_frequency.description: How often you are paid: weekly (52), biweekly (26, every two weeks, default), semimonthly (24, twice a month), monthly (12).

roth_401k_percent.description: Roth 401(k) (after-tax) contribution as a percent of gross pay, e.g. 4.

state.description: US state where you work and live, as a code or name, e.g. CA, Texas, New Jersey, NYC. Omit for federal only.

state_additional_withholding.description: Extra state withholding per paycheck in USD, e.g. 20.

state_allowances.description: Allowances or exemptions claimed on the state withholding form (state W-4), e.g. 1. Defaults depend on the state.

state_filing_status.description: State withholding form status when it differs from the federal one, e.g. NJ 'B', CT 'A', AZ '2.0' (percent). Usually omit.

w4_step2_checked.description: True if the Form W-4 Step 2 box is checked (two jobs, or married and the spouse also works). Default false.

w4_step3_amount.description: Total dollar amount on W-4 Step 3 (dependents and other credits), e.g. 4400.

w4_step4a_other_income.description: W-4 Step 4(a) other income per year (not from jobs), e.g. 2000.

w4_step4b_deductions.description: W-4 Step 4(b) deductions per year, e.g. 5000.

w4_step4c_extra_withholding.description: W-4 Step 4(c) extra federal withholding per paycheck, e.g. 50.

ytd_gross_before_this_check.description: Gross pay already received from this job earlier in 2026, e.g. 150000. Only matters near the Social Security wage base or the $200,000 Additional Medicare threshold.

b.description: Scenario B: only the fields that differ from A, e.g. {annual_salary: 110000, state: 'NY', locality: 'nyc', label: 'NYC'}. Set a field to null to remove it from B.
